title: Frappe ERPNext 15.8.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.8.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint shared across modules. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges such as portal users or users without roles, to access transaction child table rows without proper permission checks. Attackers can specify document types and filter conditions to read sensitive business document line details, potentially exposing confidential data.
